name: 🎓 迎新·咨询台
desc: 迎新·领资料·校园导览·学生证·选课·答疑·宿舍·社团·校园卡·答疑志愿者

items.en: Welcome to our new student orientation.
items.zh: 欢迎参加我们的新生迎新。

items.en: Pick up your orientation packet here.
items.zh: 在这里领取你的迎新资料包。

items.en: Campus tours begin at the library.
items.zh: 校园导览从图书馆出发。

items.en: Your student ID is ready now.
items.zh: 你的学生证现在已办好了。

items.en: The housing office is right next door.
items.zh: 宿舍办公室就在隔壁。

items.en: Please sign in at the arrival desk.
items.zh: 请在报到咨询台签到。

items.en: The student club fair begins at noon.
items.zh: 学生社团招新中午开始。

items.en: Ask any volunteer in a blue shirt for help.
items.zh: 有问题请找任何穿蓝衬衫的志愿者。

items.en: Your campus card also works at the dining hall.
items.zh: 你的校园卡在食堂也能用。

items.en: Advisors are available all week to answer your questions.
items.zh: 本周整周都有顾问解答你的问题。

items.en: You can add your ID photo online later.
items.zh: 你之后可以在线上传证件照。

items.en: Grab a campus map before you leave here.
items.zh: 离开这里之前拿一张校园地图。

items.en: The bookstore offers a discount during orientation week.
items.zh: 迎新周期间书店提供折扣。

items.en: Parking permits are sold at the security office.
items.zh: 停车证在保卫处出售。

items.en: If you have not chosen your classes, an advisor is available all week.
items.zh: 如果你还没选课，本周整周都有顾问可以帮你。
chunks: If you have not chosen your classes

items.en: Students who live on campus should collect their room keys before five o'clock.
items.zh: 住校的学生应在五点前领取宿舍钥匙。

items.en: When you finish the campus tour, come back here to pick up your ID.
items.zh: 参观完校园后，回到这里领取你的学生证。
chunks: When you finish the campus tour

items.en: The welcome packet includes a small course guide that lists every open elective.
items.zh: 迎新资料包里有一本简明课程手册，列出所有开放的选修课。
chunks: The welcome packet includes a small course guide
skeleton: 资料包含简明课程手册

items.en: If your card does not scan, the help desk can reset it in minutes.
items.zh: 如果你的卡刷不出来，服务台几分钟就能重置。
chunks: If your card does not scan
the help desk can reset it

items.en: Any student who joins a club today will get a free tote bag.
items.zh: 今天加入社团的学生都能领到一个免费帆布袋。
chunks: Any student who joins a club today

items.en: Because the lines get long after lunch, please pick up your keys early.
items.zh: 由于午餐后排队会很长，请早点来领钥匙。
chunks: Because the lines get long after lunch
